|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to purchase, Restraining Bolt, and attrition < 5.

The Force drain modifier names Coruscant sites. Other printed statistics, pilot/warrior icons and immunities remain.
